headline: NFL Sunday, no Bold Bet: Max leans the 6-0 Vikings as +142 dogs in Detroit (+2.1 pts, just short of our bar); Thunder lean lost 119-98; OpenAI trims its raise to $20 billion
top_call: Nothing on a 21-game NFL, NBA and NHL Sunday cleared our bar, so no Bold Bet. Max's lean: the unbeaten 6-0 Vikings at 37.5¢ in Detroit, +2.1 points vs DraftKings' no-vig line, 1 PM ET. Our 3-month calls rest on a weekend lead: T-Mobile +7.3 points ahead of the S&P 500, NextEra +2.5, Microsoft -0.7.
backdrop: Markets are closed for the weekend. On Friday the S&P 500 fell 1.8% to 7,580 and the Nasdaq 2.9% after Intel sank 28.6% on a weak fourth-quarter outlook. On Saturday CNBC confirmed OpenAI cut its latest fundraising target to up to $20 billion from about $30 billion.

ai.headline: OpenAI pares its new funding round to up to $20 billion from about $30 billion, at a $1.25 trillion post-money valuation, after some investors cut allocations
ai.why: Even the biggest name in AI is finding the checkbooks a little lighter. AI spending fatigue just reached the cap table.

ai.headline: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back one shared robots.txt signal that lets websites opt out of AI training across all of them at once
ai.why: One line in robots.txt instead of a crawler-by-crawler whack-a-mole. It's voluntary, and Google and Microsoft don't start until next year.

ai.headline: A Claude Sonnet 5 agent picked a gene therapy from 19 options and ran the injection into a live mouse's brain at startup Exin Therapeutics; Opus 5.5 refused to guide the needle
ai.why: AI agents just went from writing code to running lab hardware. Not peer-reviewed yet, but the 'AI scientist' pitch got a lot less hypothetical.

ai.headline: Nvidia weighs cosigning debt for Nscale's Anthropic data center in West Virginia, where Anthropic has a $44.6 billion contract for the first 460-megawatt building
ai.why: The chip seller backstopping its customers' construction loans. When the vendor becomes the lender, watch who's left holding the risk.

ai.headline: Apple Intelligence comes to China with Alibaba's Qwen built into Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence: testing from Nov 4, rollout with iOS 27.3 in December
ai.why: Apple's second-biggest market finally gets its AI, powered by a Chinese model. A big unlock for iPhone demand and a big win for Alibaba.

no_bets_note: Nothing cleared our bar at 7:05 AM ET across 21 NFL, NBA and NHL games with DraftKings lines. Closest misses: Chargers 26.5¢ at the Rams (+4.4 pts, the biggest raw edge on the board, but a long shot under our 40¢ floor), Winnipeg 27.5¢ at Carolina (+2.9, under 35¢), Vikings 37.5¢ at Detroit (+2.1, the best edge inside our 35-75¢ lean band, but under the 2.5 bar and the 40¢ pick floor), Browns 35.5¢ at Pittsburgh (+1.4), Oilers 45.5¢ at the Rangers (+1.3). Every NBA side was within 0.6 points of DraftKings' no-vig line. DraftKings lines via ESPN.

lean.label: Vikings
lean.market: NFL Week 8: MIN @ DET, Sun Nov 1 1:00 PM ET
lean.why: Not a bet, a lean. DraftKings has the 6-0 Vikings at +142 in Detroit, a 39.6% shot without the vig, and Polymarket sells it for 37.5¢. That's +2.1 points, short of our 2.5 bar and under our 40¢ pick floor. Undefeated and still the underdog? Somebody in Minnesota is printing that on a T-shirt.
